comment: Nuxel Edge Lighting policy (PWNAGE-103000). Installed read-only as the DEFAULT; the live user document is /etc/nuxel/edge-lighting/edge-lighting.json and the provider keeps it. This is an AMOLED display effect driven by real notification events, not a hardware LED and never the camera flash. Wave is the S10-style default; the default colour is the runtime Nuxel theme accent.
